questions.question: What is a map?
questions.correctAnswer: A flat drawing that shows places on Earth
questions.explanation: A map is a flat picture that shows where places are.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a map is Earth's picture, flattened out!

questions.question: What is a globe?
distractors: A flat map of a city
questions.explanation: A globe is a sphere shaped like Earth.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a globe is Earth in miniature - round like the real thing!

questions.question: What does a map's title tell you?
questions.explanation: The title names the subject of the map.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the title tells you what the map is showing!

questions.question: What is a map key, or legend?
questions.correctAnswer: A box that explains the symbols on a map
distractors: A key that unlocks a map
questions.explanation: The key explains what each symbol and color means.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the key unlocks the meaning of the symbols!

questions.question: What does a compass rose show on a map?
questions.correctAnswer: The directions: north, south, east, and west
questions.explanation: A compass rose points out the cardinal directions.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the compass rose points the way - north, south, east, west!

questions.question: Which direction is opposite of north?
questions.explanation: North and south are opposites.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: north and south are opposite ends!

questions.question: What is a map scale used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To measure real distances on a map
questions.explanation: The scale shows how map distances relate to real distances.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the scale turns map inches into real miles!

questions.question: On a map, 1 inch equals 10 miles. Two towns are 3 inches apart on the map. How far apart are they really?
questions.explanation: 3 inches x 10 miles per inch = 30 miles.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: multiply the inches by the miles each inch stands for!

questions.question: What do the lines of latitude measure?
questions.correctAnswer: How far north or south a place is from the equator
distractors: How far east or west a place is
questions.explanation: Latitude lines run east-west and measure distance north or south of the equator.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: latitude lines are the rungs of Earth's ladder!

questions.question: What do the lines of longitude measure?
questions.correctAnswer: How far east or west a place is from the Prime Meridian
distractors: How far north or south a place is
How much rain a place gets
questions.explanation: Longitude lines run north-south and measure distance east or west of the Prime Meridian.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: longitude lines slice Earth like orange segments!

questions.question: What is the equator?
questions.correctAnswer: The imaginary line around Earth's middle, at 0 degrees latitude
distractors: The line that divides east and west
questions.explanation: The equator circles Earth's middle, halfway between the poles.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the equator is Earth's belt - right around the middle!

questions.question: What is the Prime Meridian?
questions.correctAnswer: The imaginary line at 0 degrees longitude that runs through Greenwich, England
distractors: The line around the North Pole
The border of the United States
questions.explanation: The Prime Meridian divides east from west.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Prime Meridian is longitude's starting line!

questions.question: Which continent is the United States on?
questions.explanation: The United States is in North America.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the U.S. sits on North America!

questions.question: How many continents are there on Earth?
questions.explanation: The seven continents are Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Australia, and South America.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: seven continents - can you name them all?

questions.question: Which is the largest continent?
questions.explanation: Asia is the largest continent by land area.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Asia is the biggest continent of all!

questions.question: Which ocean is on the west coast of the United States?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean washes California, Oregon, and Washington.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Pacific laps the West Coast!

questions.question: Which ocean is on the east coast of the United States?
questions.explanation: The Atlantic Ocean washes the East Coast.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Atlantic laps the East Coast!

questions.question: What is a peninsula?
questions.correctAnswer: Land surrounded by water on three sides
distractors: An island in the middle of an ocean
questions.explanation: Florida is a peninsula: water on three sides.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a peninsula is almost an island - water on three sides!

questions.question: What is an island?
distractors: Land surrounded by water on three sides
questions.explanation: An island has water all around it.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: an island is land with water all around!

questions.question: What do we call the height of land above sea level?
questions.explanation: Elevation measures how high land rises above the sea.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: elevation is how high up you are!

questions.question: What is a mountain?
questions.correctAnswer: A very tall landform that rises high above the land around it
distractors: A deep hole in the ground
questions.explanation: Mountains are the tallest landforms on Earth.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: mountains are Earth's giants!

questions.question: What is a valley?
questions.correctAnswer: A low area of land between hills or mountains
questions.explanation: Valleys are low places, often with a river running through them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a valley is the low dip between hills!

questions.question: What is a plain?
questions.correctAnswer: A large, flat area of land
questions.explanation: Plains are wide, flat lands, good for farming.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a plain is flat as a pancake for miles!

questions.question: What is a plateau?
questions.correctAnswer: A flat area of land that is raised high above the land around it
questions.explanation: A plateau is like a flat-topped mountain.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a plateau is a flat table of land held up high!

questions.question: What is a canyon?
questions.correctAnswer: A deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river
questions.explanation: The Grand Canyon was carved by the Colorado River.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a canyon is a deep cut in the rock!

questions.question: What is a desert?
questions.correctAnswer: A very dry place that gets little rain
distractors: A place that is always cold
questions.explanation: Deserts get less than 10 inches of rain a year.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a desert is a place where rain almost never visits!

questions.question: What is a river?
questions.correctAnswer: A large stream of water that flows across land
questions.explanation: Rivers flow from high land to the sea.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a river is water on a long journey to the sea!

questions.question: What is a lake?
questions.correctAnswer: A body of water surrounded by land
distractors: A river that flows to the sea
questions.explanation: Lakes are still bodies of water with land all around.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a lake is water hugged by land!

questions.question: What is the mouth of a river?
questions.correctAnswer: Where the river flows into a larger body of water
distractors: The widest part of the river
questions.explanation: The mouth is the end of a river, where it meets a sea or lake.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the mouth is where the river meets the sea!

questions.question: What is the source of a river?
questions.explanation: The source is the start, often a spring or melting snow.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the source is where the river is born!

questions.question: Which is the longest river in the United States?
questions.explanation: The Missouri River is the longest river in the U.S.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Missouri is America's longest river!

questions.question: Which river forms part of the border between the United States and Mexico?
questions.explanation: The Rio Grande flows along the Texas-Mexico border.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Rio Grande is the river border with Mexico!

questions.question: What is a tributary?
questions.correctAnswer: A smaller stream or river that flows into a larger river
questions.explanation: Tributaries feed water into bigger rivers.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a tributary is a small river joining a big one!

questions.question: What is a delta?
questions.correctAnswer: Land formed by soil dropped where a river meets the sea
questions.explanation: River soil settles at the mouth and builds new land.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a delta is new land built by river mud!

questions.question: What is a glacier?
questions.correctAnswer: A huge, slow-moving mass of ice
distractors: A frozen lake that never melts
questions.explanation: Glaciers creep downhill, carving valleys as they go.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a glacier is a river of ice moving in slow motion!

questions.question: What is a volcano?
questions.correctAnswer: An opening in Earth's crust where lava, ash, and gas erupt
distractors: A tall mountain made of snow
questions.explanation: Volcanoes form when melted rock pushes up through the crust.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a volcano is Earth's pressure valve - boom!

questions.question: What is an earthquake?
questions.correctAnswer: A shaking of the ground caused by movement under Earth's surface
questions.explanation: Earthquakes happen when rocks under the surface suddenly shift.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: an earthquake is the ground shaking from below!

questions.question: What is a coast?
questions.correctAnswer: The land along the edge of an ocean or sea
questions.explanation: Coasts are where land meets the sea.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the coast is where land meets the sea!

questions.question: What is a harbor?
questions.correctAnswer: A sheltered place on the coast where ships can dock safely
questions.explanation: Harbors protect ships from storms and waves.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a harbor is a safe parking spot for ships!

questions.question: Which landform is the Grand Canyon?
questions.explanation: The Grand Canyon is a deep canyon carved by the Colorado River.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Grand Canyon is a giant canyon!

questions.question: What is climate?
questions.correctAnswer: The usual weather in a place over a long time
questions.explanation: Climate is the pattern of weather over many years.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: climate is the weather's long-term habit!

questions.question: What is weather?
questions.correctAnswer: What the air is like at a certain time and place
questions.explanation: Weather is short-term: sunny today, rainy tomorrow.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: weather is what is happening outside right now!

questions.question: Why is it hot near the equator?
questions.correctAnswer: The Sun's rays hit there most directly all year
distractors: It is close to the ocean
questions.explanation: Near the equator, sunlight hits straight on, so it stays warm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the equator gets the Sun's rays straight on!

questions.question: Why do places near the ocean often have mild temperatures?
questions.correctAnswer: Water warms and cools slowly, keeping nearby land mild
distractors: The ocean makes it rain every day
questions.explanation: Oceans act like a blanket, warming winters and cooling summers.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the ocean is a temperature blanket for the coast!

questions.question: What is a rainforest climate like?
questions.explanation: Rainforests near the equator are warm and wet year-round.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a rainforest is hot and rainy all year long!

questions.question: What is a tundra?
questions.correctAnswer: A cold, treeless region where the ground stays frozen
questions.explanation: Tundras are cold lands with short summers and frozen soil.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the tundra is a frozen land with no trees!

questions.question: Which factor affects a place's climate the most?
questions.correctAnswer: Its latitude, or distance from the equator
questions.explanation: Latitude decides how directly the Sun's rays hit.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: latitude is the biggest climate decider!

questions.question: Why are mountaintops cold even in warm places?
questions.correctAnswer: Air gets colder as elevation rises
questions.explanation: Higher elevation means thinner, colder air.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: climb high and the air gets cold!

questions.question: What are the four seasons?
questions.explanation: Earth's tilt makes four seasons as it orbits the Sun.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: spring, summer, fall, winter - the year in four parts!

questions.question: Which place would most likely have a desert climate?
questions.correctAnswer: A place far from the ocean with very little rain
distractors: A place near the equator with heavy rain
A place high in the mountains
A place on a rainy coast
questions.explanation: Deserts form where air is dry and rain is rare.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: far from rain means desert dry!

questions.question: Which region of the United States includes New York, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey?
questions.explanation: The Northeast is the region along the Atlantic coast in the north.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: New York and friends are the Northeast!

questions.question: Which region includes Alabama, Florida, and Georgia?
questions.explanation: Alabama, Florida, and Georgia are in the Southeast.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Alabama, Florida, Georgia - the Southeast!

questions.question: Which region is known for farming corn and wheat on flat plains?
questions.explanation: The Midwest's flat, rich soil grows corn and wheat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Midwest is America's breadbasket!

questions.question: Which region includes California, Oregon, and Washington?
questions.explanation: California, Oregon, and Washington line the Pacific coast.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: California, Oregon, Washington - the West Coast!

questions.question: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.explanation: Washington, D.C. is the nation's capital.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Washington, D.C. is the capital!

questions.question: Which mountain range runs along the east coast of the United States?
questions.explanation: The Appalachians stretch from Maine to Georgia.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Appalachians run down the East!

questions.question: Which mountain range runs through the western United States?
questions.explanation: The Rockies stretch from Canada to New Mexico.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Rockies tower over the West!

questions.question: Which is the largest state in the United States by area?
questions.explanation: Alaska is by far the largest state.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Alaska is huge - the biggest state!

questions.question: Which state is known as the Sunshine State?
questions.explanation: Florida's nickname is the Sunshine State.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Florida is the Sunshine State!

questions.question: Which state is an island chain in the Pacific Ocean?
questions.explanation: Hawaii is a group of volcanic islands in the Pacific.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Hawaii is islands in the middle of the Pacific!

questions.question: What is the Mississippi River known for?
questions.correctAnswer: It is a major waterway that drains the central United States
distractors: It is the longest river in the world
It flows into the Pacific Ocean
It forms the border with Canada
questions.explanation: The Mississippi carries water from the heart of the country to the Gulf of Mexico.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Mississippi is America's great central river!

questions.question: Which Great Lake is the largest?
questions.explanation: Lake Superior is the largest of the Great Lakes and the largest freshwater lake by area in the world.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Lake Superior is the biggest Great Lake!

questions.question: Which city is the largest in the United States?
questions.explanation: New York City has the largest population of any U.S. city.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: New York City is America's biggest city!

questions.question: What is the name of the region that includes Arizona, New Mexico, and parts of Texas and California?
questions.explanation: The Southwest is the hot, dry region of the desert states.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Arizona and New Mexico are the Southwest!

questions.question: Which region is called New England?
questions.correctAnswer: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and Connecticut
questions.explanation: New England is the six-state region in the far Northeast.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: six states make up New England!

questions.question: Which state borders Arizona to the west?
questions.explanation: California lies across the Colorado River from Arizona.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: California is Arizona's western neighbor!

questions.question: Which state borders Arizona to the east?
questions.explanation: New Mexico is east of Arizona.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: New Mexico is Arizona's eastern neighbor!

questions.question: Which country borders Arizona to the south?
questions.explanation: Arizona's southern border is with Mexico.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mexico is south of Arizona!

questions.question: Which city is the second largest in Arizona?
questions.explanation: Tucson, in southern Arizona, is the state's second-largest city.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Tucson is Arizona's second city!

questions.question: Why is Flagstaff cooler than Phoenix?
questions.correctAnswer: Flagstaff is at a much higher elevation
distractors: Flagstaff is closer to the ocean
Flagstaff gets more rain from the sea
Phoenix is in a valley with no wind
questions.explanation: Flagstaff sits about 7,000 feet up, so its air is cooler.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Flagstaff is high up, so it stays cool!

questions.question: What is the Colorado Plateau?
questions.correctAnswer: A high, flat region in northern Arizona with canyons and mesas
questions.explanation: The Colorado Plateau covers northern Arizona, including the Grand Canyon.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Colorado Plateau is northern Arizona's high, flat land!

questions.question: What is a mesa?
questions.correctAnswer: A flat-topped hill with steep sides
questions.explanation: Mesas are common in the Southwest, with flat tops and cliff sides.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a mesa is a flat-topped hill standing tall!

questions.question: Which Arizona city is in the mountains and gets snow in winter?
questions.explanation: Flagstaff's high elevation brings snow each winter.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Flagstaff gets real snow in winter!

questions.question: What is the name of the river that forms Arizona's western border?
questions.explanation: The Colorado River separates Arizona from California and Nevada.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Colorado River is Arizona's western edge!

questions.question: Which desert plant is a symbol of Arizona?
questions.explanation: The giant saguaro is Arizona's most famous desert plant.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the saguaro is Arizona's desert giant!

questions.question: What is the Petrified Forest in Arizona?
questions.correctAnswer: A place where ancient trees turned to stone
distractors: A forest of living pine trees
questions.explanation: In the Petrified Forest, wood from ancient trees became colorful stone.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ancient trees turned to rainbow stone!

questions.question: Which Arizona landmark is a huge hole made by a meteor long ago?
questions.explanation: Meteor Crater is a giant bowl-shaped hole from a space rock impact.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a space rock blasted Meteor Crater into Arizona!

questions.question: What is Monument Valley known for?
questions.correctAnswer: Tall red rock formations on Navajo land
questions.explanation: Monument Valley's red buttes rise from the desert floor.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Monument Valley's red towers are famous worldwide!

questions.question: Why is Phoenix called the Valley of the Sun?
questions.correctAnswer: It sits in a sunny desert valley
questions.explanation: Phoenix lies in the Salt River Valley, with sunshine most of the year.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Phoenix basks in a sunny desert valley!

questions.question: Which highway runs through Phoenix from north to south?
questions.explanation: Interstate 17 runs north-south through Phoenix toward Flagstaff.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: I-17 runs north-south through Phoenix!

questions.question: What is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.explanation: The Sahara in northern Africa is the largest hot desert in the world.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Sahara is the world's biggest hot desert!

questions.question: On which continent is the Sahara Desert?
questions.explanation: The Sahara covers much of northern Africa.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Sahara sprawls across northern Africa!

questions.question: What is the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile, in Africa, is generally considered the longest river.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Nile is the world's longest river!

questions.question: Which is the tallest mountain on Earth?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest, in the Himalayas, rises about 29,032 feet.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth!

questions.question: On which continent is Mount Everest?
questions.explanation: Everest stands on the border of Nepal and China in Asia.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Everest towers over Asia!

questions.question: What is a population?
questions.correctAnswer: The number of people living in a place
distractors: The number of buildings in a city
The number of rivers in a place
questions.explanation: Population means how many people live somewhere.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: population is a headcount of a place!

questions.question: What is a city?
questions.correctAnswer: A large place where many people live and work
questions.explanation: Cities are large settlements with many people, buildings, and jobs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a city is a big busy place full of people!

questions.question: What is a rural area?
questions.correctAnswer: Countryside with few people and lots of open land
questions.explanation: Rural areas have farms, small towns, and open space.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rural means countryside - open land and few neighbors!

questions.question: What is an urban area?
questions.correctAnswer: A city area with many people and buildings
questions.explanation: Urban areas are cities and their crowded surroundings.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: urban means city - crowds and tall buildings!

questions.question: Why do many cities grow near rivers?
questions.correctAnswer: Rivers give water, food, transport, and trade
distractors: Rivers are pretty to look at
questions.explanation: Rivers supply drinking water and a way to move goods.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rivers bring water and trade - cities grow beside them!

questions.question: What is a natural resource?
questions.correctAnswer: Something from nature that people use, like water, wood, or minerals
questions.explanation: Natural resources come from Earth and people use them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: natural resources are Earth's gifts we use!

questions.question: Which of these is a renewable resource?
questions.explanation: Sunlight keeps coming back, while coal and oil run out.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: sunlight never runs out - it is renewable!

questions.question: Which of these is a nonrenewable resource?
questions.explanation: Coal takes millions of years to form and can run out.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: coal takes millions of years to make - once gone, it is gone!

questions.question: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa is Canada's capital city.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Ottawa is Canada's capital!

questions.question: What is the capital of Mexico?
questions.explanation: Mexico City is Mexico's capital.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mexico City is Mexico's capital!

questions.question: Which country is south of the United States?
questions.explanation: Mexico shares the southern border of the U.S.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mexico is the neighbor to the south!

questions.question: Which country is north of the United States?
questions.explanation: Canada shares the northern border of the U.S.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Canada is the neighbor to the north!

questions.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the biggest ocean.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the Pacific is the biggest ocean of all!

questions.question: What is the smallest continent?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Australia is the smallest continent!

questions.question: Why do geographers study places?
questions.correctAnswer: To understand how people, places, and environments connect
distractors: To predict the weather for one day
questions.explanation: Geography explains how land, climate, and people shape each other.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: geographers study how people and places connect!
